questions.stem: Free flap reconstruction is used for which type of wound?
options: Small clean lacerations closed with sutures
Large wounds that cannot be closed primarily
Simple superficial burns that heal with dressings
Shallow cuts needing only adhesive strips

questions.answer: Treat life-threatening injuries and stabilise haemodynamics

questions.answer: Muscle, because it has a high metabolic rate

questions.answer: Maintain flap perfusion and oxygen delivery

questions.answer: The viscosity-haematocrit curve flattens and oxygen delivery falls

questions.answer: The recipient site, not the donor site

options: Has no effect on the sympathetic system

questions.answer: Warm, well-filled, sympathetically blocked patient with high cardiac output

Low SVR with wide pulse pressure

Low SVR with narrow pulse pressure
